offences.quote: may unintentionally lead to you presenting someone else's work or ideas as your own

liability.quote: Poor notetaking practices can inadvertently lead to academic integrity breaches.

detection.quote: Traditional plagiarism-detection tools are rendered ineffective in this context, as AI becomes more capable of human-like text

Detection tools which purport to specifically focus on GenAI detection raise some significant implications for privacy, equity, and data security (Dalalah & Dalalah, 2023). There is also a lack of evidence as to whether they are effective, with many institutions citing instances of false positives.

outcomes.quote: Failure to use the correct citation method may result in a reduced grade.
